exposure: Non-Operative Management (NOM) for gallbladder disease during pregnancy
Surgical management (laparoscopic cholecystectomy) for gallbladder disease during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 228 pregnant patients diagnosed with gallbladder disease between October 2012 and December 2022.
finding: Non-operative management of gallbladder disease in pregnancy is associated with a high rate of symptom recurrence and postpartum readmissions, but fetal outcomes remain favorable and no maternal-fetal complications occurred in either the NOM or surgical groups.
